tool_input.description: Replace hard-coded labels in posts pages, codegen, typecheck

result:
The blog now works in English and Japanese, with a language switcher in the header. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (8 tests, including 6 new ones) and the full `bunx guren gate` all pass. The catalog check reports both languages covering the same 29 keys.

- **Switching language:** `POST /locale` accepts `en` or `ja` from guests and signed-in users. It saves the choice in a `locale` cookie that lasts a year and redirects back to the `Referer`, or to `/` when there isn't one. Any other value, or a missing field, gets the same 422 an invalid post title gets and leaves the saved choice unchanged.
- **Browser language:** with no saved choice, `Accept-Language: ja` and `ja-JP,ja;q=0.9,en;q=0.8` both give Japanese. Once a reader has picked, their pick wins, and `_i18n.locale` reports the result on every page.
- **Pages:** the header and the posts list, post page, and new/edit forms now take all their labels from the catalogs. No page or component spells out 「記事」. I also added a "Home" link to the header, since the task lists `nav.home` as a link to `/`.

Behaviour you might not assume:
- **Referer handling:** the redirect only follows a `Referer` from this site, and uses it exactly as sent. A link from another site sends the reader to `/` instead, so the switcher can't be used to redirect people to outside sites.
- **Home and dashboard pages:** only the header is translated there. The page bodies of the home page, dashboard, login and profile are still English, because the request only covered the header and the posts pages.

The routing is in `routes/web.ts`, the handler in `app/Http/Controllers/LocaleController.ts` (with the allowed values in `app/Http/Validators/LocaleValidator.ts`), and Japanese is enabled in `src/app.ts`. The switcher is in `resources/js/components/Layout.tsx`, and the four posts pages under `resources/js/pages/posts/` use `useTranslation()`. The catalogs are `lang/en/{nav,posts,auth,locale}.json` plus a new `lang/ja/` holding the same keys, including `messages.welcome`. The new tests are in `tests/LocaleController.test.ts`, and I re-ran codegen so the key types include the new keys.
